name: 7822-sharedprefix-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams = 100, the initial 100 spread linearly over a 20 s rampup, bounded at 1200 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 20% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, one prefix bucket (bucket_weight 100, prefix_count 1, prefix_tokens 2048); per-request tail ~256 tokens (stdev 64, clamped to [128, 384]); output ~200 tokens (stdev 40, clamped to [120, 280]); `request_format: plain`, so prefix and prompt are one raw string and no chat template is applied.
purpose: An 8B chat assistant answering short questions atop a shared 2048-token document, 100 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine launch arguments for 7822-sharedprefix-8b-1gpu.
# vLLM 0.5.5-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction,
# so do not add keys from a later vLLM. Interpreter and hardware: configs/env.yaml.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
enable-prefix-caching: true
use-v2-block-manager: true
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 256
block-size: 16
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enforce-eager: false
